ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: an evening learning about {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Someone whose certainty has been shaken wants to hear another ideoligion out: an evening with a devout believer they think well of, learning what that ideoligion holds and why. Promising it arranges the evening (they walk over in the evening and spend a couple of hours together); going to an evening of that ideoligion counts too. Granted, it moves them toward that ideoligion (about 12% of certainty, more if they're open-minded and fond of the believer) and the two remember it together. Only with Ideology.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_nameDef} spends an evening with {OTHER_nameDef} hearing about {SUBJECT}, or goes to an evening of {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: I'm not as sure of my own faith as I was. I'd like to hear {OTHER_nameDef} out about {SUBJECT}, properly, one evening.
{OTHER_nameDef} seems so certain. What's that like? What does {SUBJECT} give {OTHER_objective}?
Could someone ask {OTHER_nameDef} to give me an evening? I have questions about {SUBJECT} I can't ask over supper.
[afterraid] After what happened, I keep wondering what holds {OTHER_nameDef} up. Let me ask {OTHER_objective} about {SUBJECT}.
[grieving] My faith hasn't been much comfort lately. {OTHER_nameDef} says {SUBJECT} has words for times like these.

warm.li: I like {OTHER_nameDef}, and I'd like to understand what {OTHER_pronoun} believes. Just an evening.

blunt.li: I want to hear about {SUBJECT}. From {OTHER_nameDef}. One evening.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has promised me the best stories of {SUBJECT}, if the council gives us an evening for it.

gloomy.li: I don't know what I believe any more. Maybe {OTHER_nameDef} does.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} holds to {SUBJECT}, and it seems to work for {OTHER_objective}. I want to know why.

plain.li: We talked until the fire was low. I don't know where it leaves me, but I'm glad I asked.
{OTHER_nameDef} answered everything I asked, and some things I didn't.

warm.li: Thank you for the evening. {OTHER_nameDef} was kinder about my doubts than I've been.

blunt.li: Long evening. Lots to think about.

gloomy.li: More questions than I started with. That's something, I suppose.

plain.li: I'll work out what I believe on my own, then.

gloomy.li: There was never an evening to spare. Not even for that.

plain.li: I'd still like that evening with {OTHER_nameDef}, if it can be found.
